capabilities: Add a menu entry to the search results context menu
Copy the Obsidian URI for the current search to the clipboard
Bookmark pre-defined searches via copied URLs
extras: Pre-release installs are supported via BRAT; the author hosts plugin discussions on an external forum (ActionsDotWork) with GitHub/Apple/Google sign-in. The author himself notes doubt about whether adding buttons to a core plugin is wise.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds functionality (a button) to a core plugin.
motivation: The author says: "I wanted this functionality for a while so I've built it myself. It was a good learning experience for me."
problem: Obsidian's search view offers no built-in way to capture or share a search as a reusable Obsidian URI.
summary: Search-view extension that adds a context-menu entry which copies the Obsidian URI of the current search to the clipboard.
